speech.heard: In Australia, 30% of people were born abroad. In China, it is 0%. Qatar is the world's highest. 77% of residents were born in another country. In USA, that share is 15%. In Canada, it is 22%. Across the Gulf, UAE has 74%, Kuwait has 67%, and Oman has 43%. In Europe, Switzerland has 31% born abroad. Yet in Japan, just 3% were born outside the country. Where does your country land?
